label: Finnish public pension
name: Pension name
rightsHelp: Enter the monthly amount from your pension record or provider estimate before deferral. If you already receive the pension, enter the current gross amount and mark it as in payment in Income.
kela.partnered: Full eligibility, living with a partner
kelaHelp: Select a Kela estimate if you qualify for the full residence-based amount. Enter any other pension income that reduces both benefits. Add that other income separately to your plan.
payoutHelp: Payments start on the first eligible monthly date and continue for life. The minimum age for people born from 1966 is an estimate. Choose a start after the employment you are retiring from ends.
invalid.name: Enter a pension name of up to 80 characters.
invalid.owner: Select a pension recipient with a valid birth year and month.
invalid.right: Enter a nonnegative gross monthly pension amount.
invalid.receiving: Choose whether the pension is already in payment.
invalid.other: Enter a nonnegative gross monthly amount for other pensions.
invalid.start: Choose a valid age, date or milestone for the pension start.
